prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background plate for The Gates, an ancient magical temple slot game. Create a NEW original cinematic high-detail 3D painted environment, wide 1536x1024 landscape. Dark blue-black basalt temple interior, immense weathered carved columns on both far sides, delicate antique brass filigree, ancient runes glowing softly turquoise, warm torch bowls far left and far right, atmospheric dust, a few embers, worn stone steps at bottom. Empty dim recessed stone wall across the central 70 percent for an overlaid game board. An ornate sealed bronze double doorway at the extreme right within the last 18 percent, subtle cyan light leaking at the seam. View straight on, symmetric architectural lines, tangible obsidian stone and brushed antique gold, premium sophisticated fantasy game rendering, restrained illumination, cinematic depth. No game symbols, no UI, no text, no logo, no grid, no numbers, no people, no watermark. Keep middle region quiet and very dark; ornament clustered at edges.

prompts.gateDoors: Production game texture atlas, NOT a mockup. A perfectly aligned TWO COLUMN by TWO ROW grid, 1024x1536 portrait. Each of the four equal 512x768 cells is entirely filled edge to edge by ONE pair of CLOSED rectangular temple door leaves, front-on orthographic. All four doors share identical rectangular proportions and a perfectly straight vertical center seam. No arch, no outer frame, no columns, no surroundings, no text. Detailed embossed sculpted metal and stone, physically rendered fantasy temple craftsmanship. Top-left: BASE temple door, aged bronze and blue-black basalt, geometric ancient guardian relief, turquoise runes and thin cyan center seam. Top-right: NORMAL bonus door, rich gold, huge ornate sun medallion relief centered on seam, concentric solar rays carved across both leaves, warm amber light. Bottom-left: SUPER bonus door, lavish pale gold, large spread phoenix wings across the pair of leaves with emerald gemstone feather insets and vivid emerald center seam, luxurious and powerful. Bottom-right: HIDDEN bonus door, black obsidian and aged crimson-gold metal, enormous horned guardian face carved across the seam, ruby gemstones, angular ominous patterns and deep red glowing seam. Very ornate high-detail tangible materials, complex engraved trim INSIDE each door pair, convincing depth and shadows, polished premium slot fantasy game quality. Four clearly DIFFERENT designs, not merely recolors. Every design fits its exact cell, zero gutters and zero padding, no elements cross cell edges. Do NOT include anything outside these four door surfaces. Entire atlas opaque.
